subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Adverse
solution:
The correct answer is: Propitious.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Adverse"** means something that is preventing success or development; harmful or unfavourable. (प्रतिकूल)

 
 
• **Example:** The **adverse **weather conditions forced us to postpone the event.
 
 
 
• **"Propitious"** refers to something that gives or is likely to give a good result; favourable. (अनुकूल)
 
 
• **Example:** The clear skies and calm winds were **propitious **signs for the journey ahead.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Adverse'** is **'Propitious'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Striking** (प्रभावशाली): Attracting attention by reason of being unusual, extreme, or prominent.

 
 
• **Example:** The painting's **striking **colors immediately caught everyone's attention.
 
 
 
• **Critical** (आलोचनात्मक): Expressing adverse or disapproving comments or judgments.
 
 
• **Example:** The review was highly **critical **of the new play.
 
 
 
• **Listless** (उदासीन): Lacking energy or enthusiasm.
 
 
• **Example:** He felt **listless **after the long, exhausting week.
